query:
*[_type == "ticketType" && slug.current == $slug && active == true][0]{
    _id,
    name,
    "slug": slug.current,
    demo,
    active,
    price,
    regularPrice,
    description,
    capacity,
    show,
    releasedQuantity,
    earlyBirdCutoff,
    requiresDaySelection,
    requiresAttendeeNames,
    provisional,
    category,
    capacityPool,
    headcountPerUnit,
    excludedDays
  }

result.description: Single-day general admission to the National Show — choose your day.
result.name: Day Visitor Ticket
